title: Discovery of Bimetallic Hexagonal MBene Mo2ErB3T2.5 (T = O, F, and Cl)
summary: Discovery of Bimetallic Hexagonal MBene Mo2ErB3T2.5 (T = O, F, and Cl). ML stability screening followed by first-principles checks nominated candidates for a bimetallic i-MBene. Mo2ErB3T2.5 was synthesized and showed hydrogen-evolution performance. Evidence limits: Only one of the 47 predicted-stable candidates was made; benchmark performance not assessed. Reviewed from Europe PMC abstract only.
